title: Sync pnpm-lock.yaml with metadata package dependencies
body:
CI failing on install step: `pnpm-lock.yaml` missing entries for `packages/metadata` dependencies added in 2831c2f.

### Changes

- Updated lockfile with metadata package dependencies (chokidar, glob, js-yaml, vitest, workspace packages)
- Added auto-generated JSON schemas for `metadata-loader.zod.ts` definitions (12 files in `packages/spec/json-schema/system/`)

The metadata package was added with its package.json but lockfile wasn't regenerated, causing frozen-lockfile CI checks to fail.
